name: agent-teams
description: Six agent teams for Claude Code, each with a defined shape: defect-hunt-until-dry (loop until dry), hypothesis-duel (competing-hypothesis debugging), design-panel (blind-scored designs ending in an ADR), incident-timeline-postmortem (cited timeline and causal chain), spec-mutation-tests (spec to tests proven by mutation) and worktree-migration (one mechanical change across many modules, one branch per module). Least-power roles, blind verification with planted canaries, read-only critics and caps enforced in code.
